mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trail WHERE id = #{value}

SELECT id AS id, trail_id AS trailId, chain_sequence AS chainSequence, section_sequence AS sectionSequence, window_m AS windowM, distance_m AS distanceM, estimated_elevation_start AS estimatedElevationStart, estimated_elevation_end AS estimatedElevationEnd, estimated_elevation_delta AS estimatedElevationDelta, estimated_slope_percent AS estimatedSlopePercent, data_quality_flag AS dataQualityFlag, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom, 9) AS geometryGeoJson FROM slope_section WHERE trail_id = #{trailId} AND window_m = #{windowMeters} ORDER BY chain_sequence, section_sequence

SELECT ts.id AS segmentId, ts.from_node_id AS fromNodeId, ts.to_node_id AS toNodeId, ST_Length(ts.geom::geography) AS lengthMeters, ts.source_trail_feature_id AS sourceTrailFeatureId, tf.dn_value AS sourceDn, ST_AsGeoJSON(ts.geom, 9) AS geometryGeoJson FROM trail_segment ts JOIN trail_feature tf ON tf.id = ts.source_trail_feature_id WHERE tf.trail_id = #{value}
